panels.title: Paramètres natifs 9450c — états et procédé
panels.description: Dernières valeurs générées par le simulateur selon le modèle de données de l’imprimante.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and (r._field == "jet_status_code" or r._field == "printing_status_code" or r._field == "motor_speed_rpm" or r._field == "pressure_10mbar" or r._field == "viscosity_tenth_second"))
  |> group(columns: ["printer_id", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["printer_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["printer_id", "jet_status_code", "printing_status_code", "motor_speed_rpm", "pressure_10mbar", "viscosity_tenth_second"])
  |> rename(columns: {printer_id: "Imprimante", jet_status_code: "Code jet", printing_status_code: "Code impression", motor_speed_rpm: "Moteur (tr/min)", pressure_10mbar: "Pression (10 mbar)", viscosity_tenth_second: "Viscosité (0,1 s)"})

panels.title: Consommables — deux échéances
panels.description: Compare l’épuisement et l’expiration. « Facteur limitant » indique l’échéance prioritaire ; « agir dans » pilote les alertes.

targets.query:
base = from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and (r._field == "ink_level" or r._field == "ink_hours_to_empty" or r._field == "ink_days_to_expiry" or r._field == "ink_action_days" or r._field == "ink_expiry_limited" or r._field == "solvent_level" or r._field == "solvent_hours_to_empty" or r._field == "solvent_days_to_expiry" or r._field == "solvent_action_days" or r._field == "solvent_expiry_limited"))
  |> group(columns: ["printer_id", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["printer_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
ink = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({Consommable: "Encre", Niveau_pct: r.ink_level, Heures_avant_vide: r.ink_hours_to_empty, Jours_avant_expiration: r.ink_days_to_expiry, Facteur_limitant: if r.ink_expiry_limited == 1.0 then "Expiration" else "Consommation", Agir_dans_j: r.ink_action_days}))
solvent = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({Consommable: "Solvant", Niveau_pct: r.solvent_level, Heures_avant_vide: r.solvent_hours_to_empty, Jours_avant_expiration: r.solvent_days_to_expiry, Facteur_limitant: if r.solvent_expiry_limited == 1.0 then "Expiration" else "Consommation", Agir_dans_j: r.solvent_action_days}))
union(tables: [ink, solvent])
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {Niveau_pct: "Niveau (%)", Heures_avant_vide: "Heures avant vide", Jours_avant_expiration: "Jours avant expiration", Facteur_limitant: "Facteur limitant", Agir_dans_j: "Agir dans (j)"})

from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and (r._field == "ink_level" or r._field == "solvent_level"))
  |> group(columns: ["printer_id", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "ink_level" then "Encre" else "Solvant"}))

panels.title: Viscosité de l’encre par rapport à la consigne
panels.description: Consigne : 4,2 ; plage acceptable : ±0,3. La viscosité dérive avant que la qualité d’impression ne baisse visiblement.

targets.query: from(bucket: "printer_monitoring") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and r._field == "ink_viscosity") |> group() |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

panels.title: Pression et température de la tête d’impression

targets.query:
from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and (r._field == "head_pressure" or r._field == "head_temperature"))
  |> group(columns: ["printer_id", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "head_pressure" then "Pression de tête" else "Température de tête"}))

from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_telemetry" and (r._field == "filter_hours_remaining" or r._field == "jet_run_hours" or r._field == "pump_run_hours"))
  |> group(columns: ["printer_id", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "filter_hours_remaining" then "Filtre restant" else if r._field == "jet_run_hours" then "Fonctionnement du jet" else "Fonctionnement de la pompe"}))

import "array"
real = from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_event" and r.event_type == "fault" and (r._field == "description" or r._field == "duration_s" or r._field == "message_id"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "code", "demanding"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "code", "description", "demanding", "duration_s"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Date", code: "Code", description: "Description", demanding: "Ligne en production", duration_s: "Durée (s)"})
fallback = array.from(rows: [{Date: time(v: 0), Code: "-", Description: "Aucun défaut enregistré", "Ligne en production": "-", "Durée (s)": 0.0}])
union(tables: [fallback, real])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Date"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)

panels.title: Pareto des défauts — temps perdu sur 30 jours

targets.query:
import "array"
real = from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_event" and r.event_type == "fault" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group(columns: ["code"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with cause: if r.code == "E-042" then "Pression d’encre hors plage" else if r.code == "E-051" then "Viscosité de l’encre hors plage" else if r.code == "E-073" then "Buse partiellement obstruée" else if r.code == "E-088" then "Défaut de gouttière" else if r.code == "E-067" then "Capot ouvert" else if r.code == "E-095" then "Déclenchement manqué" else r.code}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["cause", "_value"])
fallback = array.from(rows: [{cause: "Aucun défaut enregistré", _value: 0.0}])
union(tables: [fallback, real])
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "secondes perdues"})

panels.title: Historique des consommables
panels.description: Chaque lot installé et son état final. Des lots remplacés encore pleins indiquent une cadence de commande inadaptée.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "printer_monitoring")
  |> range(start: -365d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "printer_event" and r.event_type == "refill" and (r._field == "message_id" or r._field == "expires_on" or r._field == "opened_on" or r._field == "manufactured_on" or r._field == "volume_ml"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "consumable_type", "batch_code", "part_number"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with consumable_type: if r.consumable_type == "ink" then "Encre" else "Solvant"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "consumable_type", "batch_code", "part_number", "opened_on", "expires_on", "volume_ml"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 30)
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "Installé le", consumable_type: "Consommable", batch_code: "Lot", part_number: "Référence", opened_on: "Ouvert le", expires_on: "Expire le", volume_ml: "Volume (ml)"})
